units.title: Skip and Jump
steps: This is skip counting. These are multiples!

units.title: Building Rectangles
units.description: Seeing how many ways we can arrange objects.
steps: Take 6 stones. You can put them in 1 row of 6, or 2 rows of 3.
The numbers 1, 2, 3, and 6 are 'factors' because they fit perfectly.
